SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, p.title AS title, p.est_duration AS estDuration, p.applicant_count AS applicantCount, p.budget AS budget, DATEDIFF( LEAST( DATE_ADD(DATE(p.created_at), INTERVAL 30 DAY), DATE_SUB(p.start_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ), CURDATE() ) AS dday, CASE WHEN #{userId} IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_bookmarks pb WHERE pb.project_id = p.project_id AND pb.user_id = #{userId} ) END AS bookmarked FROM projects p WHERE p.is_public = TRUE
AND LEAST( DATE_ADD(DATE(p.created_at), INTERVAL 30 DAY), DATE_SUB(p.start_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) >= CURDATE()
AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.project_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects p WHERE p.is_public = TRUE
AND LEAST( DATE_ADD(DATE(p.created_at), INTERVAL 30 DAY), DATE_SUB(p.start_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) >= CURDATE()
AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects WHERE created_at >= CURDATE() AND created_at < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects WHERE LEAST( DATE_ADD(DATE(created_at), INTERVAL 30 DAY), DATE_SUB(start_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) >= CURDATE() AND LEAST( DATE_ADD(DATE(created_at), INTERVAL 30 DAY), DATE_SUB(start_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 8 DAY)

SELECT project_id, client_id, title, description, start_date, deadline_date, est_duration, budget, communicate_method, payment_method, change_policy, max_revision_count, project_status, is_public, created_at, updated_at, view_count, applicant_count FROM projects WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
